item.title: Telangana Assembly Budget Session likely from 26 Feb
item.description: The date for the Telangana Assembly Budget Session has been confirmed. The government has scheduled the legislative proceedings to commence from 26th February. On the opening day, Governor Jishnu Dev Verma will address both Houses of the Assembly. The following day will feature a debate on the motion of thanks to the Governor's address. The budget for the financial year 2026-27 is expected to be presented to the Assembly on 28th February.

item.title: PM Modi Unveils MANAV Framework At AI Impact Summit, Pushes For Inclusive And Human-Centric AI
item.description: At the AI Impact Summit in Delhi, PM Narendra Modi presented the MANAV framework for AI governance, urging global leaders to democratise artificial intelligence and ensure it empowers people, especially in the Global South.

item.title: Jay Pawar Demands Transparent Probe Into Baramati Plane Crash, Flags Possible Lapses
item.description: Jay Pawar has called for a fair and transparent investigation into the Baramati plane crash that killed former Maharashtra Deputy CM Ajit Pawar, raising concerns over safety lapses and accountability.

item.title: Pulwama Man Arrested For Impersonating NIA Officer, Duping Delhi Job Seekers
item.description: Delhi Police arrested a Pulwama resident for posing as an NIA officer and cheating economically vulnerable families by promising jobs in Delhi in exchange for money.
